data.name: Cephas
data.gender_notes: Cephas is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Aramaic 'Kepha' meaning 'stone' or 'rock'. In Christian tradition, this name is given to St. Peter, the apostle who is said to have been the first pope. The name Cephas carries the meaning “Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cephas usually hope their child will grow to embody rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, stability, and foundation in faith.
data.etymology: Cephas belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cephas total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: כפה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כפה (Cephas) - פירוש: שְׁמוֹ של ראש הכנסייה, המקור בעברית: כְּפֶה, שְׁמוֹ של פֶּתַח החותם, השם מוזכר בכתובים: 'אֲדֹנִי, לָמָּה תִּקְרָא לִי כְּפֶה' (איל 4:13).

in_greek.name: Κέφας
in_greek.long_meaning: Κέφας (Cephas) - Πέριμερος: ονομασία του πρώτου Πάππου, προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη Κεφάλαιο, που σημαίνει kepáleo (κεφαλαιόω), αιρέω (αἱρέω), και είναι μια μεταφραστική απόδοση της Εβραϊκής λέξης Κέφες (Κεφα).

in_latin.name: Cephas
in_latin.long_meaning: Cephas - Significatio: nomen primi Papae, ab Hebraeo Cepha derivatum est, quod significat 'capitulum' vel 'petra'. In Evangelio Iesu dicit: 'Tu es Petrus, et super hanc petram aedificabo ecclesiam meam' (Matthaeus 16:18).

in_english.name: Cephas
in_english.meaning: meaning: name of the first Pope, derived from Hebrew 'kepha' meaning 'rock' or 'capstone'
in_english.long_meaning: Cephas - meaning: name of the first Pope, derived from Hebrew 'kepha' meaning 'rock' or 'capstone', biblical reference in Matthew 16:18, symbolizing spiritual foundation and strength.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Cephas" is most famously associated with St. Peter, the fiery and passionate apostle who is said to have been the rock on which Jesus built His Church (Matthew 16:18). Peter's name in Greek is 'Petros', meaning 'rock', and this connection solidified the significance of the name "Cephas" as a symbol of strength, stability, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name "Cephas" carries the deeper spiritual meaning of being a 'rock' or 'pillar' of faith and devotion. It serves as a reminder of Peter's unwavering belief in Jesus and his commitment to spreading the teachings of Christ to the world. The name inspires those who bear it to build their lives on a solid foundation of faith, just as Peter did when he declared, "You are the Christ, the Son of the Living God" (Matthew 16:16).
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cephas, or Peter in Greek, means "rock" in Aramaic. This name symbolizes Peter's role as a foundation of the Christian faith, as Jesus declared him to be the rock upon which His Church would be built. (Matthew 16:18)

biblical_reference.note: reference to the first Pope Peter

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Cephas is mentioned in the New Testament as a name for Simon Peter. The name Cephas carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Cephas is a name used in the Catholic Church for the Pope.
Cephas is a given name in the English-speaking world.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Cephas remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Cephas in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Cephas, which means "Rock". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
